WITH site_averages AS (
    SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS avg_faces
    FROM sites s
    JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
    GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat
), status_averages AS (
    SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_faces) AS avg_site_faces
    FROM site_averages
    WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY entrystat
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(facetfaces) AS avg_faces
    FROM scanmesh m
    JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref
), qualifying_sites AS (
    SELECT sa.avg_faces, sta.avg_site_faces, oa.avg_faces AS overall_avg_faces
    FROM site_averages sa
    JOIN status_averages sta ON sta.entrystat = sa.entrystat
    CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
    WHERE sa.entrystat IS NOT NULL
      AND sa.avg_faces > sta.avg_site_faces
      AND oa.avg_faces IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(avg_faces) AS average_face_count,
       AVG(avg_faces - overall_avg_faces) AS average_above_overall,
       AVG(avg_faces - avg_site_faces) AS average_above_status
FROM qualifying_sites;
